card.text: White supergiant about 433 parsecs away; its photosphere is not imaged here.

introduction.text: Deneb is a white supergiant roughly 130 times the Sun’s radius, at a poorly known distance of about 433 parsecs. Here its surface is a plain sphere.

shape.title: Sphere of the measured radius
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size in neutral gray. No picture of the surface is cast here.
